note: Irregularities observed while researching the DOE GEMS Prize Challenge. Each entry is a factual observation, not an accusation.

entries.observation: The user prompt cites two different 'current' leaderboard high scores: 0.4413 and 0.3195. Neither matches the official DrivenData public leaderboard fetched 2026-10-27, which shows #1 xiaofanhu at 0.4544 (public DW-Tversky). 0.3195 appears as rank #25 (kpomazi), not the high score; 0.4413 does not appear in the top 29 rows fetched. Conclusion: user-cited leaderboard numbers are stale; treat 0.4544 (public leaderboard, organizer-published) as the verified bar to beat.
entries.action: Do not write any of the user-cited numbers as scores. Label everything from team sites as team-published/unverified; label leaderboard values as ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED public leaderboard only.

entries.observation: The competition data tab (training_features.tif, labels.tif, sample_submission.tif, 1m_DEM_links.csv) requires DrivenData login; anonymous redirect to login was verified. This sandbox has no DrivenData credentials and none were requested. True holdout DTI and leaderboard-eligible scoring therefore cannot be completed here.
entries.workaround: Owner-supplied integrity-pinned GitHub mirrors (sha256 in registry/data_manifest.json) are used to restore data for development. Mirrors are integrity-pinned, NOT organizer-authenticated. Official data must be re-verified against drivendata.org before any slot is spent.

entries.observation: Scores published on the GEMSDOE team sites (e.g. GEMSDOE32 h33-h33-2-b2-...-zeros: 0.2778) are team-published claims. They do not appear as submission names on the public DrivenData leaderboard and cannot be independently verified from this repository.
entries.action: Label as team-published (unverified) in the executive summary table; never restate as organizer-confirmed.

entries.observation: Dropbox scl/fi competition-data links in the prompt return HTTP 000 from this sandbox (network restrictied to github.com, pypi.org and related hosts).
entries.source: Dropbox links listed in the prompt (example_submission.tif, existing_faults.tif, gems-geodawn-numerical-features.tif, GEMS_96647.pdf)
entries.action: Documented as unavailable; grid geometry recovered from the owner-mirror manifest instead (EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, 100 m, origin 243350/4508550).

entries.observation: No DrivenData auth exists in this environment, so no submission can be uploaded automatically. The generated TIF is downloadable from the GitHub Pages site; the user must upload it manually via the DrivenData submission page.
entries.action: Site documents the manual submission steps and the exact note text (<=140 chars).
